expected: MOV_ARTIFICIAL_EDGE_UNKNOWN 9:7-9:32 '-[:@previous]->': '@' names an edge the engine makes, not one a system declares — the only one is '@old' (the record as it stood before a write) (see handbook: writes#what-the-write-did)

MOV_HANDLE_READ_FOUND 10:33-10:69 since "Luminous Owl" (4) 'created' on 'org' reads the record as the write found it; before, it read what the system handed back from the write (often nothing). MOV_HANDLE_FIELD_RETIRED 10:33-10:69 'created' is no longer a field of a write's handle since "Luminous Owl" (4) — ask the record before the write instead: `EXISTS(h-[:@old]->)` is FALSE when this write created the record; `FIRST(h-[:@old]->) == h` when it was only rehearsed; compare fields against `FIRST(h-[:@old]->)` for what changed (see handbook: writes#what-the-write-did)

cases.name: a hop's LIMIT where the source takes none
cases.source:
import { cap } from adapters
import { cap_cred } from credentials

c = cap(credentials: cap_cred)
movement main(msg: <c-[:company]->>) {
  n = COUNT(msg-[p:staff LIMIT 3]->)
  k = COUNT(msg-[p:people LIMIT 3]->)
}
listen to c fire main
expected: MOV_LIMIT_NEEDS_ORDER 6:7-6:37 'staff' comes back in no particular order, so 'LIMIT 3' takes some 3 of them — a different 3 each run. Say which ones you mean with an ORDER BY (`-[:staff ORDER BY `…` DESC LIMIT 3]->`).
MOV_HOP_LIMIT_UNSUPPORTED 6:7-6:37 'staff' can't be limited here — this source doesn't support LIMIT across that relationship.

MOV_LIMIT_NEEDS_ORDER 7:7-7:38 'people' comes back in no particular order, so 'LIMIT 3' takes some 3 of them — a different 3 each run. Say which ones you mean with an ORDER BY (`-[:people ORDER BY `…` DESC LIMIT 3]->`).

import { email, attio, kg } from adapters
